recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up core source work is needed unless a future work group issue reopens VisionPrescription.created cardinality or wording.
issue_request: FHIR-18029 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core FM change request, raised and applied for STU3, asking to add VisionPrescription.created as a 0..1 dateTime creation-date element.
initial_application: The issue was applied in commit 9c9403324df70351bf59981a05828a59d6b2b723, whose subject lists GF#18029. That commit added created values to VisionPrescription examples and added VisionPrescription.created to the historical spreadsheet source as a dateTime element, using 1..1 cardinality with the short description "Response creation date" and definition "The date this resource was created."
additional_context: FHIR-19490, a later Published/Persuasive issue in the same VisionPrescription change family, explicitly requested VisionPrescription.created to be 1..1; that audit is already represented on the combined branch. The 2021 source rework preserved the element into the current StructureDefinition XML. VisionPrescription is active in source/fhir.ini and now mapped to OO. Community searches found no directly relevant or conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative StructureDefinition already contains VisionPrescription.created as a dateTime with min 1 and max 1, so the seed request is satisfied when interpreted together with the later cardinality decision.
